one_line: A card game where players build a stable of seven unicorns while playing Neigh, Magic, Upgrade and Downgrade cards to wreck each other.
A fast card game of kitty-powered Russian roulette: draw cards, dodge the Exploding Kitten with a Defuse, and play action cards to make others draw instead.
A social-deduction card game for 5-10 players where Resistance operatives vote teams on to missions while hidden Imperial spies try to sabotage them.
A fast bluffing card game where each player holds two hidden characters, claims abilities whether true or not, and tries to be the last with influence.
A card game from the Unstable Unicorns team where each player builds a party of heroes from seven classes, rolls dice for their effects and races to slay three monsters.
A cooperative Lovecraftian board game where investigators explore Arkham, fight monsters and race to stop an Ancient One in modular scenarios.
A Viking miniatures game where clans draft cards each age, fight over provinces and try to die gloriously before Ragnarok destroys the board.
A worker-placement farming game where dwarf families dig caves, furnish rooms, farm and go on expeditions to build the highest-scoring home.
A team word game where each side gives coded clues so teammates can decode a secret number sequence while the other team tries to intercept it.
A mancala-style game where you move meeples around a 30-tile sultanate board, then trigger tribe powers, tile actions and Djinns to score the most.
A card game where you build a forest of trees and the animals, plants and mushrooms that live on and around them, scoring from each species.
A fantasy deckbuilding game from the Star Realms team where heroes buy champions and actions from a shared market to defeat opponents.

base_game: Robinson Crusoe: Adventures on the Cursed Island
one_line: A cooperative survival game where castaways build shelter, hunt, explore and fight the weather over several scenarios, with a win or loss that is hard to dodge.
A roll-and-move fantasy adventure where each hero races across a shared board toward the Crown of Command, with luck deciding most fights, so the game is long and swingy.
A fast two-player spaceship deckbuilder where you buy ships and bases from a shared trade row and attack your opponent's 50 authority.
A pick-up-and-deliver race through a bazaar where you push a merchant and his assistants around a grid of 16 places, trading goods to collect five rubies first.
A two-sided campaign of the Galactic Civil War, where one player runs the Empire hunting a hidden Rebel base while the other runs the Rebellion building support for the final fight.
A solo-friendly dice-building RPG where Gearloc heroes roll and build their own dice pools to fight Baddies over four days and finally topple a Tyrant.
A civilization game with no map conquest, where you advance on four tracks, play tapestry cards and build a capital city over five eras.
A Viking worker-placement game where you place a worker to gather a crew, then use that crew to raid and plunder coastal settlements for the most glory.
A dice-rolling engine builder where you buy starship cards for twelve sectors and rolling the matching number pays out rewards for you and your opponents.
A family-friendly tile-laying game where you grow bamboo, irrigate a garden and feed a giant panda to complete secret objective cards.
A card-drafting and engine-building game where you draft development cards and recycle or build them to grow your empire over four rounds.

base_game: The Lord of the Rings: Journeys in Middle-earth
one_line: A cooperative campaign adventure game where heroes explore a map, fight miniature enemies and run quests through a companion app.

base_game: Betrayal at House on the Hill
one_line: A haunted-house exploration game where players build the house room by room until a haunt starts and one explorer turns traitor.
